sloka: ततो दुःख अभिसंतप्तो लक्ष्मणो वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् ।विचरन् दण्डक अरण्यम् भ्रातरम् दीप्त तेजसम् ॥३-६१-२३॥
transliteration: tato duḥkha abhisaṁtapto lakṣmaṇo vākyam abravīt ।vicaran daṇḍaka araṇyam bhrātaram dīpta tejasam ॥3-61-23॥

translations.english: Going about the Dandaka forest Lakshmana, consumed by sorrow, said to his brother, glowing with brilliance:
